items.title: Holy Bible
items.body: We accept the sacred words of the 66 Books of the Bible as the inspired revelation of God, the sheet anchor of our faith and eternal hope, and the basic creed of the church. The Holy Bible is the only standard of life for the believer.

items.title: God
items.body: The Eternal, True, and Holy Trinity is one God, existing in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

items.title: Man
items.body: Man was created in the likeness of God, but fell when he transgressed God's commandment. Only Jesus Christ, the Son of God, can restore fallen man to his pristine glory.

items.title: Salvation
items.body: The fallen should approach God with true repentance and faith in the atoning death of Christ. We are justified by faith. The Blood of Christ pardons our guilt, and the Blood of Jesus, the Word of God, and the Holy Spirit sanctify the believer.

items.title: The Church
items.body: The church is the congregation of believers; its faith and experience should conform to and stand steadfast in the teaching of the apostles in the New Testament. Evangelization is the supreme duty and privilege of the church.

items.title: Coming of Christ
items.body: Jesus Christ is coming soon, and His Bride, the Church, will be caught up with Him in the air. At the end of the tribulation He will return in all His glory with His saints and establish His Kingdom of Righteousness for a thousand years.
